summary: Completed comprehensive frontend testing of Ramadan Iftar app after ad removal and menu system implementation. Found React app functioning well with minor issues on daily menu visibility.

ui_bugs.issue: Menu section not visible in React app - appears to be implemented in static export only
ui_bugs.description: The daily Ramadan menu system with 29 unique menus is not present in the React frontend, only in static export

design_issues.description: Automated testing detected CSS classes containing 'ad' substring (like 'leading', 'padding', 'shadow') as potential advertisements, but these are legitimate Tailwind/Radix classes

passed_tests: ✅ No actual advertisement content (reklam.png references completely removed)
✅ Countdown timer displays and updates properly (19:08:XX format)
✅ Ramadan progress bar displays correctly during Ramadan period
✅ Schedule modal opens and shows 30 days of prayer times
✅ Aksam (Iftar) prayer time is properly highlighted with green border
✅ Theme toggle functionality works (dark/light mode switch)
✅ Footer displays correct credits (Diyanet and Seyrani Kenger)
✅ No console errors or JavaScript errors detected
✅ No empty spacing where ads used to be
✅ Prayer times grid displays properly with all 6 prayer times
action_item_for_main_agent: Implement the daily Iftar menu system in the React app (/app/frontend/src/App.js) as it appears to only exist in the static export. The menu system should show 7 items per day (1 soup, 1 main dish, 1 side dish, 1 salad, 2 meze, 1 dessert) using the deterministic seeded algorithm from the static export.
